title: NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Quote Window for Insured-Requested Coverage Increases
content:
### Quote window for coverage increases the insured requests (NFIP Dwelling Form Flood Policies (Write Your Own))

**Clause.** For a pending coverage increase the insured requested with no loan transaction, on a tier that carries no ICC coverage, the quote window is measured from the request date to the receipt date and is 60 days when the increase was requested with the coming term's renewal premium, 30 days when the request carries a full-term risk premium from the rating engine, and no days otherwise; when the receipt date falls outside the window, the increase may take effect no earlier than 30 days after the receipt date.

| Request | Window | Inside when the receipt date is |
|---|---|---|
| Requested with the coming term's renewal premium (a payment for the term starting on the current term end, posted on or after the request date) | 60 days | 60 days or fewer after the request date |
| Otherwise, the request carries a full-term risk premium from the rating engine | 30 days | 30 days or fewer after the request date |
| Otherwise | No days | The request date itself |

The receipt date is the later of the request date and the date of the latest premium payment on the policy received on or after the request date. *Hypothetical case:* a rated request whose premium is posted 45 days after the request date falls outside its 30-day window; had it been paid with the coming term's renewal premium, 45 days would fall inside the 60-day window.
